title: Workforce Education and Development, B.S. — Industrial Education Specialization (College of Education)
notes: Historical year built from the archived 2025-26 bulletin (raw HTML, not WebFetch's summary, per the batch's anti-hallucination instruction; the page's own per-semester subtotals -- 14.5+16+17+17+15+15+13.5+13 -- sum to its own printed 'Total Credits 121', confirming internal consistency). Confirmed byte-identical to WFED-2022/2023/2024/2026.json's Suggested Academic Plan course sequence and to the 'Industrial Education Option (43 credits)' Program Requirements course list; identical Entrance-to-Major requirements (3.00 cumulative GPA, 80 documented experience hours) and identical Begin/End Campus text (Any Penn State Campus / University Park). This is the most recent archived edition before the live 2026-27 bulletin WFED-2026.json is built from, and the two are functionally identical in every respect checked (course sequence, options, credit totals, campus text) -- the only difference is this edition still carries the same restructured Gen Ed policy text introduced in 2023-24 (see WFED-2023.json's notes), which doesn't affect any item in this plan. Same real prereq-order bug confirmed present this edition too (WFED 441 requires WFED 445, WFED 442 requires WFED 441, yet both are printed before WFED 445 in the Suggested Academic Plan) -- applied the identical WFED 105 -> WFED 445 -> WFED 441 -> WFED 442 reordering used by every other year in this set. 'Additional Courses' item (Semester 7) still prints the stale 'STS 245Z' code in this edition too; per the confirmed Z->N rename documented in WFED-2023.json's notes (verified again this edition holds STS 245N, not 245Z, in university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/sts/), modeled the item as LDT 100 / STS 245N / WFED 450, all three confirmed real for this edition. Same flag as prior years for the reviewing process: WFED-2026.json's own item for this slot lists only WFED 450, omitting the real LDT 100 option (and, since the live 2026 catalog no longer has any STS 245Z/245N course at all per WFED-2026.json's own note, this 2025 file is the last year for which a real STS 245-series substitute genuinely exists) -- not edited in WFED-2026.json here, outside this batch's assigned scope.
